correctness.rationale: The weighted matrix-tree/Cauchy–Binet identity applies to independently signed spoke/path edges and identifies each Walsh multiplier with an integer tridiagonal determinant (not a positive-weight-only Laplacian). The fan tree count F_{2n} has parity zero precisely at multiples of three. All spoke weights -1 and path weights +1 yield leading minors 1,0,-1,-1,0,1, periodic, and determinant zero iff 3|n; otherwise a ±1 witness realizes the exact odd gap. At n=3k flipping the first spoke gives determinant 2(-1)^k, which with even parity proves gcd and nonzero gap 2. Kernel vector (1,0,-1,-1,0,1,...) has zero coordinates at indices congruent 2 mod 3; independent spoke flips and global edge reversal produce 2^(k+1) different zero masks. Walsh diagonalization yields pseudoinverse/condition-number statements. Independent exact signed determinant complete sign enumeration n=1..8 gave zero counts 0,0,10,0,0,304,0,0 and sharp min 1,1,2,1,1,2,1,1; source check_fan_walsh.py reviewed and constructs a different full spanning-tree enumeration/certifier. This does not infer all-n claims solely from a finite run.

value.rationale: Signed spanning-tree transforms determine exact invertibility and stability of Boolean-edge convolution for a natural family with unbounded path length. The sharp periodic spectral gap and explicit exponential null-family are a meaningful structural combinatorial-harmonic result, beyond merely recomputing Fibonacci counts or a finite table.

final_claim: For the unnormalized spanning-tree indicator Walsh transform of fan F_n=K_1 join P_n (n>=1), Fourier zeros occur iff 3 divides n. The exact minimum nonzero absolute Walsh coefficient and gcd are 2 in those resonant n and 1 otherwise. There are at least 2^(n/3+1) zero frequencies when 3 divides n. The convolution pseudoinverse norm is 1/2 resonant and 1 nonresonant, and positive-subspace condition numbers are F_{2n}/2 and F_{2n}.
